notes: Single handwritten mathematical page, full-image dimensions 1691 x 2373. Half a is 1691 x 1266; half b is 1691 x 1267. Whole, a and b were each viewed exactly once, in that order, before the 16 one-time crops.

The page describes a strictly increasing type map on the set/order of subobjects, its bounded image, the largest object d_n, a bijection from Hom to a type fiber, and an induced injective map into Hom of the subobject orders. These are reported manuscript claims, not independently checked results.
The two J index pairs are different in the ink: n-prime,n in the definition and n,n-prime in the terminal diagram. No repair or mathematical inference has been entered.
No explicit author doubt such as a question mark or verbal reservation was located. The uncertainty macros are reader doubts, chiefly overlapped deletions and weak marks.
No title, date or author folio is present at the top. A 7 stands at bottom left and is recorded as the archive sheet number, not a new manuscript folio.
No reused typed text is recoverable. Faint background texture does not establish a typed verso; the sheet is classified text.

The first two read commands mistakenly sought the packet and images below SP48_CW_104; they failed before any image delivery. The supplied root-relative paths were then used. This did not create an extra image view. The started timestamp is the first clock sample recorded after the brief and preamble had been read.
No OCR, recognition, web research, other page, other reader output, subagent, compilation or rendering was used. No mathematical proof/computation check was performed.

C’s terminal TikZ diagram was reused after checking its objects, two right arrows, labels, open curl-ended lower curve and lack of a lower arrowhead. Two small detached-mark traces were added elsewhere without assigning semantic functions.
